title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: LiteLLM
providers.scope_notes: Covers LiteLLM Proxy (AI Gateway). Self-hosted open-source proxy (MIT) with an Enterprise license gating JWT auth, IP filtering, audit logs and key rotation; all controls are operator config on your own deployment.
controls_unknown: Whether /key/delete and /key/block take effect instantly or after an auth-cache TTL (only SCIM deprovisioning is documented as clearing the cache).
Master key expiry and SCIM token expiry, rotation and revocation steps.
Whether management GET calls (/key/info, /key/list, /spend/logs) are logged anywhere besides server logs.

authentication.summary: Bearer token created under Settings > Admin Settings > SCIM, used by the IdP to call /scim endpoints.

federation.details: Static token held by the IdP.

ip_restriction.boundary: allowed_ips applies to proxy endpoints; /scim/v2 routes use the same user_api_key_auth path that runs the IP check (from source). Docs do not name /scim routes explicitly. Enterprise.

renewal.summary: Create a new token in the UI; rotation/revocation steps not documented.

administration.summary: Created by admins in the Admin UI; can deprovision users, which blocks their keys.

offboard.details: Token is created for the IdP provisioning connection, not a person.

log_sources.name: Audit Logs (LiteLLM_AuditLog)
log_sources.notes: Enterprise; on by default with license, else store_audit_logs: true. UI Logs -> Audit Logs; export via audit_log_callbacks (e.g. S3). Retention is your DB.

log_sources.name: Spend logs (LiteLLM_SpendLogs)
log_sources.notes: Per-request rows with key hash; no prompt content by default; can be disabled; retention via maximum_spend_logs_retention_period.

containment.steps: Not documented; manage in Settings > Admin Settings > SCIM.

calls.log_notes: Audit logs track only Create, Update, Delete and Regenerate on keys, teams, users and models; reads are outside that scope. Enterprise.

unknown: SCIM endpoints a holder could read (e.g. user lists) not documented in fetched pages
